# Eloquence/OpenEVV reference source
Imported from https://github.com/trypsynth/evvdroid by GitHub Actions.
This is a **reference snapshot from public upstream**, not a byte-for-byte import
of the user's supplied ZIP. See LICENSE and native/openevv/NOTICE.

The upstream IBM-derived language data under native/openevv/lang,
proprietary-derived tables, binary artifacts, and bundled release signing
keystore have deliberately NOT been imported. As a result, this directory
cannot be built into a working Eloquence voice as-is.

Its source is retained for inspection and adaptation of the Android TTS service,
JNI bridge, text preprocessing, and engine infrastructure. Public redistribution
of IBM language/voice data requires separate permission.
